query: SELECT world.generation_stage, world.initial_prompt, world.storyteller_summary, world_generation.spent, questioner.agent_id AS questioner_agent_id, questioner_chat.branch_id AS questioner_branch_id, storyteller.agent_id AS storyteller_agent_id, storyteller_chat.branch_id AS storyteller_branch_id FROM world JOIN world_generation ON world_generation.world_id = world.id JOIN world_role_agent AS questioner ON questioner.world_id = world.id AND questioner.role = 'questioner' JOIN agent_history AS questioner_chat ON questioner_chat.agent_id = questioner.agent_id JOIN world_role_agent AS storyteller ON storyteller.world_id = world.id AND storyteller.role = 'storyteller' JOIN agent_history AS storyteller_chat ON storyteller_chat.agent_id = storyteller.agent_id WHERE world.id = ?
